chip.description: Secure serial flash with password-gated read/write access, from Xicor's PASS (Password Access Security Supervisor) line; deployed as a security/key chip on Sega NAOMI hardware and Konami System 573 carts.
chip.notes: Q3: password-gated access control is the part's designed purpose (it is what distinguishes it from a plain serial EEPROM), so protection rather than memory.
